name: claude-code-ui
author: Claude Code UI
description: Desktop Claude Code UI for visual AI coding workflows

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n server,client,electron -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5174/api/health && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5174 electron ."
